integrity.originality_risk: A general spectral framework or unindexed paper may implicitly entail the same formula; record searches alone cannot establish uniqueness.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact reduction to the balanced product-graph component, matrix Cauchy–Binet and singular-value formulas.
integrity.reproducibility: verify.py independently evolves all tensor arcs; NumPy required.
integrity.source_date_basis: First arXiv v1 submission 2026-07-10, checked on public arXiv source.

scientific_limitations: Only the specified graph-product Grover coin, opposite-edge exchange-symmetric/antisymmetric initial states, and finite complete bipartite graphs.
Entropy is particle-factor von Neumann entropy of the specified labeled tensor-arc representation; no assertion of operational entanglement under indistinguishability superselection.
Numerical verification tests finite graphs only; general quantifiers are proved through exact matrix identities.
The known regular-biclique saturation classification is prior work and is not asserted to be novel.
title: Exact Schmidt spectra and a uniform entropy ceiling for two-particle Grover walks on complete bipartite graphs
